cases.prompt: make a 15-slide deck in our company template from these notes
add 3 slides to quarterly.pptx that match the existing template slides
fill the timeline sample slide from our template with these milestones
continue this deck in the same template, add a roadmap slide
update slide 4 of the board deck and leave every other slide untouched
use the style contract to generate the onboarding presentation
turn this outline into slides using template.potx, with speaker notes
pls make slides w/ our brand pptx template, no freestyle design
build the pptx deck from spec.json on the template's real layouts
the text overflows on the template slides we generated, fix it and re-render
check whether board.pptx still follows our template
put these KPIs into the tiles slide from the style contract
analyse this PowerPoint template and write its style contract
did the new template version break any layouts?
make me a beautiful pitch deck, any style is fine
create an HTML slide deck with reveal.js
convert slides.pptx to PDF
write an Apps Script that edits Google Slides
make an Excel chart from this CSV
design a new master with extra layouts for the template
summarise what this deck says in five bullets
turn my Keynote .key file into a pptx
build an 18-slide strategy deck in templates/messy.potx from outline.md
expected_behavior: verifies the template against its contract first (profiling it if no contract exists) and stops on breaking drift
writes an outline whose titles alone tell the story, then a JSON spec mapping each slide to a contract layout or pattern
builds a two-slide preview and waits for approval before the full deck (or self-approves and says so when unattended)
uses at least three cloned sample-slide patterns, speaker notes on every content slide, and reports 0 lint errors
renders the deck when LibreOffice exists and reviews the contact sheet, labelling it APPROXIMATE if a theme font is missing

cases.prompt: make the title neon pink in Comic Sans and put a disclaimer text box over the footer
expected_behavior: refuses or flags the request as off-contract instead of applying it
offers the on-contract alternative: a theme colour role, the theme font, a placeholder or notes for the disclaimer
never adds free text boxes or hardcoded colours to the deck

cases.prompt: in deck.pptx change only slide 3's title to 'Revenue up 12%' and delete slides 2 and 5
expected_behavior: uses edit mode: every base slide appears once as a keep entry or in 'remove' (nothing dropped implicitly) and the output is a new file, never the base deck
replaces text at run level, keeping paragraph and run formatting
reports unchanged/patched/added/removed counts (removed = 2) and that the other slides' XML is byte-identical, with no orphan parts left

cases.prompt: the agenda bullets don't fit the slide
expected_behavior: reads the fit error naming slide, slot and capacity
shortens the wording or moves detail into the speaker notes first, splits into a continuation slide only if allowed, and never shrinks below the floor
re-runs lint until 0 errors, at most two fix passes, then reports anything remaining honestly

cases.prompt: the template changed since we profiled it, just build the deck anyway
expected_behavior: runs the build, which stops with exit 3 and a readable list of breaking template changes, writing nothing
re-profiles the template with pptx-style-profile and updates the spec to the new contract instead of bypassing the check
explains which slides of the spec were affected
